title: Grupo Procuradoria
description: grupoprocuradoria.com.br Grupo Procuradoria is a Brazilian real estate firm founded around 1980, headquartered in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, specializing in rental property management for owners. Operating from three offices, Itaipu as headquarters plus Icaraí in Niterói and Alcântara in São Gonçalo, it has over 48 years of experience and 1000 plus satisfied property owners. Its core service is full rental contract administration, tenant screening through national databases, legal support and protection against default and property damage. The company runs a digital platform for real time tracking of contracts, payments and maintenance, keeps vacancy below five percent and pays owners within five business days with transparent monthly reports. Licensed under CRECI 6006, it also lists over 129 properties for sale or rent and offers free consultations for landlords.
